Name: Simple Journal Pin
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Journal Pin[/size][/b]
Keep your important quests in view with a small, readable tracker that fits Stardew Valley’s style.
Pin up to [b]6 quests[/b] from your normal Journal and follow their objectives while you play.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic pinning:[/b] New quests are pinned by default when a slot is available.[/*]
[*][b]Manual control:[/b] Pin or unpin quests using the checkboxes in your Journal.[/*]
[*][b]Live progress:[/b] See item requirements, counters and completed objectives.[/*]
[*][b]Actual item icons:[/b] Uses loaded game sprites, including supported modded items.[/*]
[*][b]One tracker:[/b] No tracker pages or scrolling. The layout becomes more compact when space is limited.[/*]
[*][b]Optional background:[/b] Keep the parchment panel or use shadowed text without a background.[/*]
[*][b]Quick access:[/b] Click a tracked quest to open its Journal entry.[/*]
[*][b]Controller support[/b] and [b]all 12 game languages[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Per-player settings:[/b] Each farmer keeps their own pins and display preferences.[/*]
[/list][heading]How It Works[/heading]
Open your Journal and tick the box beside a quest to track it.
[b]Auto-Pin New Quests is enabled by default.[/b] Existing quests are not automatically pinned when you install the mod. Manually unpinned quests stay unpinned.
When all six slots are full, new quests remain unpinned. Nothing is automatically replaced. Completed or removed quests leave the tracker and free their slot.
Use the controls below the Journal to change auto-pinning, compact display and the background.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.4.0+.[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]SimpleJournalPin[/b] folder inside your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]To update, close the game and replace the existing SimpleJournalPin folder.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Supports standard Journal quests and Special Orders, including the quest structures used by [b]Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp[/b].
Where structured progress is available, the tracker displays live counters. Other objectives use their existing localized quest text. Unusual custom quest systems may need additional support.
Includes spacing support for [b]UI Info Suite 2 Alt’s status icons[/b]. Mods that replace the Journal or add other HUD panels may require compatibility adjustments.
[heading]Save Safety[/heading]
The mod tracks your quests without changing their progress, rewards or completion rules. It can be removed without removing your quests.
Updating from version 1.0.0 keeps your first six valid pins in order. Any additional quests remain in the Journal.
[heading]Reporting Issues[/heading]
Please include your [b]SMAPI log[/b], a screenshot and the affected quest’s name.
